messages.subject: Hale v Wexford Holdings - executed settlement agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Bartlett,

Please find attached the settlement agreement executed by the Company. We understand Mr Hale has signed and that you have completed the adviser's certificate at Schedule 1. On that basis the agreement is now effective. Please arrange for the claim (2204187/2025) to be withdrawn within 7 days as provided in clause 6. Payment will be made within 28 days.

messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Gallagher,

Noted with thanks - countersigned copy and signed certificate attached separately. We will file the notice of withdrawal with the Tribunal this week. It has been a pleasure dealing with you on this matter.

Regards,
Eleanor Bartlett
Partner
Ashworth Quinn LLP
60 Gracechurch Street, London EC3V 0HR
